rationale: At tip a8ac1fc4, `git show a8ac1fc4 --stat` reports exactly the advertised 8-file patch (199 insertions, 38 deletions). Inspection of the full patch confirms it is confined to the six Round 2 residual groups described in the Round 3 addendum: metadata-family escaping plus its hostile real-chain regression; crash-window comment honesty; three function-anchored citations; bead-2 attribution; agreement-table prose precision; and the ADR/code-comment trust-boundary disclosure. The only runtime change is the complete-package metadata seam default routing through RenderBDError while preserving Unwrap; the remaining changes are tests, comments, or documentation. None touches the spec-approve success tail, ApproveSpec real-executor behavior, or the Round 2 regressions that established R4's empirical lifecycle basis. My standing verdict is therefore unchanged.
